Package io.telekom.orchest.enginecore.bpmn

Interface WorkflowEngine

All Known Implementing Classes:
OrchestWorkflowEngine
public interface WorkflowEngine
Core interface for the workflow engine. Defines methods to deploy, start, resume, and signal processes. Serves as the primary API for interacting with the BPMN execution engine.

    • resumeActivity

      void resumeActivity(String processInstanceId, String activityId, io.telekom.orchest.api.core.request.Variables variables)
      Resumes execution of a process instance at a specific activity. Typically used to complete a wait state (e.g., User Task, Receive Task).

      processInstanceId - The ID of the process instance.
      activityId - The ID of the activity to resume.
      variables - Variables to merge into the process instance.

    • handleProgressiveRetry

      void handleProgressiveRetry(io.telekom.orchest.api.core.adapters.data.model.TimedEvent timedEvent)
      Handles a progressive retry event triggered when a TASK_RETRY timed event fires. The TimedEvent document is removed after processing (including early exits).
      Parameters:
      timedEvent - The timed event (TASK_RETRY) that fired; must include TimedEvent.getEventRequest().
